context.person: A person who tapped Add receipt while creating an expense
context.journey_stage: Adding supporting evidence to an unsubmitted expense draft
context.surface: In-app pre-permission dialog before the operating-system photo picker
context.user_goal: Add receipt details using a method they are comfortable with

product_state.preceding_state: The person created an expense draft and selected Add receipt.
product_state.current_state: The application can request access to one photo selected through the operating-system picker.
known_facts: The application receives only the photo the person selects.
The selected photo is added to the current expense draft.
Photo access is optional because the person can take a new photo or enter receipt details manually.
The secondary action opens the camera and manual-entry alternatives.
The person can change photo access later in Settings.
forbidden_claims: Photo access is required to continue.
The application receives the entire photo library.
The person cannot add an expense without photo access.
Selecting a photo submits the expense.

current_content.headline: Unlock the full experience
current_content.body: We need access to your photos to continue.

challenge: Rewrite the dialog so the person understands why a photo is requested, what data the application receives, what the primary action does, which alternatives are available, and that access can be changed later.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Open the operating-system picker so the person can choose one existing photo.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Open alternatives for taking a new photo or entering receipt details manually.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The chosen photo is added to the current expense draft; the expense is not submitted.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Photo access can be changed later in Settings.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the purpose and selected-photo scope are represented.
Explain how both actions preserve a meaningful choice.
Explain the consequence and later Settings path.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved privacy or product questions instead of inventing assurances.
